views: 左から FRONT 0度、SIDE 真横90度で顔は画面右、BACK 180度。3体のみ、同じ身長スケールと頭頂・足底ライン、自然に腕を下ろした中立立ち姿。
design_constraints: 青年男性、黒い乱れた短髪、眠そうな顔、生成りシャツ、紺上着、茶パンツ、軽い革靴。武器・鎧・余計な小物なし。
back_view_completion_note: 上着の背面、シャツ裾、短髪の後頭部だけを合理的に補完。新装飾なし。
prompt:
Use the single input image only as the exact adopted character design and style reference. Create ONE wide horizontal character turnaround sheet containing exactly three full-body views of the same person, arranged left to right: FRONT, SIDE, BACK. Put a small unobtrusive English label FRONT, SIDE, BACK beneath each view; no other text. This is a strict orthographic design sheet, not a scene.
All three figures must have identical height scale, identical head-top and sole baseline, the same neutral standing pose with arms naturally slightly away from the body, and generous margin around every figure. Front is exactly 0 degrees, side is exactly 90 degrees in profile with the face looking toward screen right, back is exactly 180 degrees. No 3/4 angle, no perspective, no dramatic lighting, no large cast shadow, no extra character, no duplicate limbs. Preserve the adopted design's exact face, head shape, hair color, hairstyle, eye color, clothing, palette, equipment and proportions. Use the established Tina-style bold dark outline, large simple color areas, hard 2-3 step cel shading, warm ivory/white flat background. Keep long hair at its adopted length and let it fall naturally down the back. For asymmetrical equipment, keep it attached to the same character side and rotate it correctly in side/back views. Do not invent new decorations or weapons; only make minimal logical hidden/back-surface completion where necessary.
Character: Kai from the adopted image. Preserve clearly male young-adult proportions and sleepy half-lidded dark eyes, messy short black hair, tired neutral expression, off-white shirt, navy simple jacket, brown pants and light brown leather shoes. Keep his compact Tina-style head and body but do not feminize him or enlarge his eyes into a cute female style. No armor, weapon, shield, staff, cape or extra props.
side_facing_note: 要求どおり、SIDEの横顔は画面右向きとして生成・確認。
